what: Master Version 2.32 — postwar sets taken off Lionel MPC-Modern. The book's Section 8 'Cataloged Sets 1945-1969' (pages 516-523) and its set boxes (pages 486-515) had been typed in with the modern items, so those sets sat on MPC-Modern with made-up years. 395 rows removed: each is a postwar set already on Lionel PW - Sets (6 carry numbers the book never prints — misreads of a neighbour). 3 rows whose number is also a modern Lionel engine, with that engine's Lionel link already on the row, get the engine's words: 11212 Nickel Plate Road Berkshire "765", 11232 Reading 4-4-2 Atlantic "351", 11268 Strasburg 2-6-0 Mogul "89". Kept: 4 real postwar sets not yet on PW - Sets (1538WS, 2149B, 2222WS, 12502) and 15 real modern sets that share a postwar number.
